name: Niche Capital Emas Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，Niche Capital Emas Holdings Berhad 通过子公司 NICE REE Sdn Bhd 与 Greensnow Consolidated Berhad 签订谅解备忘录，在 Terengganu、Kelantan 和 Pahang 联合开发稀土勘探、开采和加工项目，并推进与 StrategicREM, LLC 的稀土矿物承购谈判。同时，集团与 Enrich Mining Sdn Bhd 的勘探谅解备忘录到期后不再延长，集团将集中开发位于 Kelantan 的 KK Hill 矿区（约 97.12 公顷）。
overview_en: In 2026, Niche Capital Emas Holdings Berhad, through its subsidiary NICE REE Sdn Bhd, entered into a memorandum of understanding with Greensnow Consolidated Berhad for the joint development of a rare earth exploration, extraction and processing project in Terengganu, Kelantan and Pahang, and progressed offtake negotiations for rare earth minerals with StrategicREM, LLC.

segments.name: 采矿与矿产勘探
segments.note: 今年重点推进与 Greensnow 的稀土项目及与 StrategicREM 的承购谈判，同时 Enrich Mining 勘探备忘录到期不续，转向集中开发 KK Hill 矿区。
segments.note_en: This year focused on advancing the rare earth project with Greensnow and offtake negotiations with StrategicREM, while the Enrich Mining exploration MOU lapsed and focus shifted to developing the KK H…

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: StrategicREM 要求将就最终承购协议提供反馈的期限延长至 2026 年 12 月底。
actions.text_en: StrategicREM requested an extension until the end of December 2026 to provide feedback on the proposed definitive offtake agreement.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: MIDA 将 Greensnow Precision Sdn Bhd 稀土分离与加工厂的项目实施期从 2026 年 12 月 25 日延长至 2027 年 12 月 25 日，谅解备忘录有效期至 2027 年 5 月 6 日。
actions.text_en: MIDA extended the project implementation period of Greensnow Precision Sdn Bhd's rare earth separation and processing plant from 25 December 2026 to 25 December 2027; the MOU remains valid until 6 May 2027.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Enrich Mining Sdn Bhd 的勘探谅解备忘录不再延长，于 2026 年 11 月 30 日到期后失效；集团将集中开发位于 Kelantan 的 KK Hill 矿区（约 97.12 公顷）。
actions.text_en: The exploration MOU with Enrich Mining Sdn Bhd will not be further extended and lapsed upon expiry on 30 November 2026; the group will concentrate on developing the approximately 97.12-hectare KK Hill mining area in Kelantan.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: Greensnow Precision Sdn Bhd 正在向 MIDA 申请稀土分离与加工厂的完整制造许可证，预计在批准函发出后六个月内取得。
actions.text_en: Greensnow Precision Sdn Bhd is in the process of obtaining the full manufacturing licence from MIDA for its rare earth separation and processing plant within six months from the date of the approval letter.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 承购方 StrategicREM 已完成现场采样，正在美国对钪、镝、铽、钇四种重稀土元素进行实验室测试。
actions.text_en: Offtaker StrategicREM has completed field sampling and is conducting laboratory testing in the US on four heavy rare earth elements: scandium, dysprosium, terbium and yttrium.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Enrich Mining Sdn Bhd 的勘探谅解备忘录延长三个月至 2026 年 11 月 30 日，以继续在 Sejana 项目开展勘探工作。
actions.text_en: The exploration MOU with Enrich Mining Sdn Bhd was extended for three months until 30 November 2026 to continue exploration works in the Sejana project.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: NICE REE Sdn Bhd 与 Greensnow Consolidated Berhad 同 StrategicREM, LLC 签订稀土矿物承购谅解备忘录，为谈判最终承购协议建立框架。
actions.text_en: NICE REE Sdn Bhd and Greensnow Consolidated Berhad entered into an offtake MOU for rare earth minerals with StrategicREM, LLC, establishing a framework to negotiate a definitive offtake agreement.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 子公司 NICE REE Sdn Bhd 与 Greensnow Consolidated Berhad 签订谅解备忘录，在 Terengganu、Kelantan 和 Pahang 联合开发离子吸附型稀土勘探、开采和加工项目。
actions.text_en: Subsidiary NICE REE Sdn Bhd entered into an MOU with Greensnow Consolidated Berhad for the joint development of an ion-adsorption clay rare earth exploration, extraction and processing project in Terengganu, Kelantan and Pahang.

model_changes.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
model_changes.text: 通过子公司 NICE REE Sdn Bhd 与 Greensnow Consolidated Berhad 合作，新增稀土勘探、开采和加工业务线。
model_changes.text_en: Through subsidiary NICE REE Sdn Bhd, partnered with Greensnow Consolidated Berhad to add a rare earth exploration, extraction and processing business line.

model_changes.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
model_changes.text: 与 Enrich Mining Sdn Bhd 的勘探合作到期不续，集团勘探活动转向集中开发 KK Hill 矿区。
model_changes.text_en: The exploration collaboration with Enrich Mining Sdn Bhd lapsed without extension, with the group's exploration activities shifting to focus on developing the KK Hill mining area.
